title: Make `model` mandatory in `DICLOptimizationConfig`
body:
It's awkward to provide a default model they might not have configured.
Right now it's `openai::gpt-4o-mini-2024-07-18`, which is also already pretty stale.
Let's make this field mandatory.

This can be a gradual deprecation (warn if no value provided and use current default; later make it mandatory).

linked_prs.title: Deprecate default `model` in `DICLOptimizationConfig`
